items.title: Underdog sues Tennessee over prediction market rules, FocusGN reports
items.content_text: - **Underdog sues Tennessee over prediction market rules, FocusGN reports** — Underdog filed a federal lawsuit in the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Tennessee in Nashville against Attorney General Jonathan Skrmetti and members of the Tennessee Sports Wagering Council, arguing federal authority preempts state efforts to regulate its prediction markets as gambling. The filing follows the Sixth Circuit decision allowing Ohio and Tennessee regulators to apply state gambling laws to Kalshi sports contracts, and Underdog says enforcement poses a direct and imminent threat to its business and users. items.title: Hyperliquid Policy Center urges SEC to adopt crypto rules with five changes, Crypto.news reports
items.content_text: - **Hyperliquid Policy Center urges SEC to adopt crypto rules with five changes, Crypto.news reports** — The Hyperliquid Policy Center announced on October 19 that it filed a comment letter urging the SEC to adopt its proposed Regulation Crypto Assets framework with five changes covering token airdrops, secondary trading, developer protections, buybacks and state securities requirements.
